page_title: SUN 2-2 ARS | Sunderland v Arsenal 08/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Hjelde L. F. Achilles Tendon Injury

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Craig Pawson has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

90+7' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball towards the roof of the net. Robin Roefs shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Arsenal.
90+5' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Craig Pawson signals that the goal stands! The Sunderland players celebrate.
90+5' Maybe there was an infringement in the build up to the Sunderland goal as the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.

90+4' 2 - 2 Wonderful movement! Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) perfectly times his run onto a brilliant cross and smashes the ball from deep inside the box straight into the roof of the net. What a finish.
90+2' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Sunderland is cautioned for aggressive play.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
88' Mikel Arteta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cristhian Mosquera (Arsenal) replacing Eberechi Eze.
87' Substitution. Lutsharel Geertruida did his best and is replaced by Eliezer Mayenda (Sunderland).
87' The Sunderland players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
83' Shots on target – 1:6.
81' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
80' Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the bottom right corner, but is denied by a reflex save from David Raya.
78' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
77' A pass by Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is behind the touchline and Sunderland will take a throw-in.

74' 1 - 2 Goal! Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top left corner. Robin Roefs had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:2.
72' Reinildo Mandava (Sunderland) is booked by the referee.
71' Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Eberechi Eze, but Robin Roefs displays great awareness to stop him.
71' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) commits a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
70' A player from Sunderland commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
70' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) takes a direct free kick.
65' Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) gets a shot from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar!
64' It's time for a substitution. Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) comes on in place of Bertrand Traore.
64' Regis Le Bris decides to make a substitution. Enzo Le Fee will be replaced by Simon Adingra (Sunderland).
63' It is time for a substitution. Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) is on for Wilson Isidor.
58' Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
57' Arsenal keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
54' 1 - 1 Goal! Mikel Merino tees up Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 1:1.

52' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
50' Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
49' Good work from Sunderland as they win a corner.
47' Arsenal control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+10' The end of the first half.
45+9' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
45+6' Gabriel (Arsenal) finds Martin Zubimendi with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.

45+3' William Saliba (Arsenal) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He creates some space for the shot, but blazes it high over the crossbar. Very bad attempt. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
45+1' A yellow card for a tackle by Granit Xhaka (Sunderland). Craig Pawson doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
45' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
45' Wonderful movement by Arsenal. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
43' Referee Craig Pawson sees the trip by Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
41' Gabriel (Arsenal) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
36' 1 - 0 Daniel Ballard (Sunderland) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets inside the right post.
36' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) for a tough tackle.
35' What an amazing save by Robin Roefs! Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the middle of the target, but fails.
34' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
30' The game is interrupted now, Trai Hume (Sunderland) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
30' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
29' Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
27' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Craig Pawson saw the whole situation.
25' Lutsharel Geertruida (Sunderland) and Daniel Ballard matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.

24' Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
23' Sunderland are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes.
21' Declan Rice (Arsenal) sends an accurate short pass. Martin Zubimendi controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
20' Reinildo Mandava (Sunderland) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball has crossed the sideline. Sunderland are taking a throw-in.
19' Poor challenge! Reinildo Mandava (Sunderland) is penalised for tripping and Craig Pawson blows his whistle.
16' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner with a short pass.
15' Declan Rice (Arsenal) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Robin Roefs to dive and make a save.
14' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
13' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Arsenal.
11' Neat passing move from Arsenal in order to create new attacking opportunities.
7' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
6' Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) tries to find Bertrand Traore, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
5' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Arsenal.
4' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) and Declan Rice combine well with some one-touch passing and are gradually building up to an attack.
1' The first half has started.
Sunderland will kick-off.
Craig Pawson is introduced as the referee for today's match.
